title: Senyum di Antara Rak-Rak
theme: Menjelajahi bagaimana kebaikan kecil di tengah kesunyian malam kota dapat menumbuhkan koneksi tak terduga dan harapan baru.

cover.prompt: A deserted city street in the very early hours of the morning. A lone scooter is gently parked under the soft, cool glow of distant streetlights. The scene emphasizes wide, still pathways and quiet urban architecture receding into the distance. A subtle, soft luminescence emanates from a small handheld screen, hinting at a moment of pause and solitude. The overall atmosphere is tranquil and reflective.
cover.style: Moody atmospheric illustration, soft lighting, painterly style

meta.plan_summary: Adi, an online ride-hailing driver, finds his quiet night shift brightened by an unexpected encounter with Maya, a cheerful minimarket cashier. Their brief, warm conversation about their night routines creates a unique connection, leaving Adi with a lighter heart and renewed hope for the lonely city nights.
meta.target_emotion: Hati yang ringan, harapan, kebahagiaan, kehangatan
